info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listIndexers reports the deployment's chain indexer(s) and how far each has indexed.
get.description:
listIndexers reports the deployment's chain indexer(s) and how far each has indexed.

Identity and health come from the indexer's /health; the latest indexed block
(height and time) from /v1/explorer/blocks.
The row EXISTS if EITHER call reaches the indexer; when the indexer is entirely
unreachable it degrades to an honest-EMPTY list (200), not a console-error 502.
No chain HEAD is exposed by the indexer REST, so `lag` is honestly omitted
rather than fabricated.

get.summary: listOracles reports the on-chain price and data oracles the graph indexes.
get.description:
listOracles reports the on-chain price and data oracles the graph indexes.

The source is luxfi/graph's O-Chain PriceFeed registry — a REAL registry, the
graph's own oracle resolver.
A reachable graph with no feeds returns an honest empty list; an unreachable or
erroring graph likewise degrades to an honest-EMPTY list (200), not a 502.
No feed is ever fabricated.

chain.description: Chain is the indexed chain's name as the indexer reports it.

height.description: Height is the latest indexed block height; empty when nothing is indexed yet.

id.description: ID identifies the indexer — its chain name, else chain id, else the brand.

lag.description:
Lag is always absent: the indexer REST exposes no chain HEAD, so lag is not
derivable and is omitted rather than invented.

network.description: Network is the deployment's network tier: mainnet, testnet or devnet.

status.description: Status is active, or degraded when /health explicitly reports unhealthy.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the latest indexed block's time, RFC3339 UTC.

indexers.description:
Indexers is one row per chain indexer this deployment is wired to; empty
when no indexer is reachable, never a fabricated row.

feed.description: Feed is the trading pair the oracle prices, e.g. LUX/USD.

id.description: ID identifies the feed — its upstream id, else the trading pair.

name.description: Name is the human label for the feed, normally the trading pair.

source.description: Source is the oracle network the feed originates from.

status.description: Status is active for any listed feed.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the feed's own timestamp, RFC3339 UTC.

value.description: Value is the feed's latest price, verbatim from the graph.

oracles.description:
Oracles is one row per on-chain price feed; empty when the graph is
unreachable or carries no feeds, never a fabricated feed.
